shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'git status -sb && cat package.json && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.required-path.test.ts && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && cat specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'

/bin/zsh -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\" && rg -n 'node_modules/ajv\"|\"ajv\":' package-lock.json | head -20 && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && ls scripts/spec-links && command -v lore-query-trace || true && git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat jest.config.js && cat tsconfig.json && cat .github/workflows/ci.yml && ls node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv* && rg -n 'ajv|moduleNameMapper' jest* package-lock.json | head -35 && cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -80"

/bin/zsh -lc "git log -3 --oneline && git show a845390:package-lock.json | sed -n '4875,4890p' && node -p \"require.resolve('ajv')\" && cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | head -25 && rg -n 'ajv' tsconfig* && cat AGENTS.md"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts | head -30 && cat node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts | head -25 && ls -a | rg 'AGENTS|lore' && cat CHANGELOG.md | head -30"
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat AGENTS.md | head -100 && command -v lore-query-trace || true && git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"import type {ValidateFunction} from 'ajv/dist/ajv.js';\\n\",'')
s=s.replace(\"const Ajv = AjvModule as unknown as typeof import('ajv/dist/ajv.js').Ajv;\", \"interface ValidationError {\\n  instancePath?: string;\\n  dataPath?: string;\\n  keyword: string;\\n  params: Record<string, unknown>;\\n}\\n\\ninterface ValidateFunction {\\n  (input: unknown): boolean;\\n  errors?: ValidationError[] | null;\\n}\\n\\ninterface ValidatorEngine {\\n  compile(schema: object): ValidateFunction;\\n}\\n\\nconst Ajv = AjvModule as unknown as {\\n  new (options: Record<string, boolean>): ValidatorEngine;\\n  prototype: object;\\n};\")
s=s.replace(\"private readonly ajv = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false});\", \"private readonly ajv = new Ajv({\\n    strict: false,\\n    validateFormats: false,\\n    ...("'!('"'_addVocabularies' in Ajv.prototype) && {jsonPointers: true}),\\n  });\")
s=s.replace(\"const path = error.instancePath || '/';\", \"const instancePath = error.instancePath ?? error.dataPath ?? '';\\n        const path = instancePath || '/';\").replace('"'`${error.instancePath}/${property} required`'"','"'`${instancePath}/${property} required`'"')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.legacy-path.test.ts"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'inputSchema' src/types/ai.ts && git diff --stat && git diff && cat .lore/dod.md | tail -20"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='.lore/dod.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('- [x] Name the full path of a missing nested required property in schema rejection messages.', '- [x] Name the full path of a missing nested required property in schema rejection messages.\\n- [x] Handle validator error paths and types across the AJV versions reported by CI.')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.legacy-path.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md"

/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.legacy-path.test.ts && git commit -m "Handle validator error path variants" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb'
